tasks.short: Plan locations and sequences of fabrication operations

steps.what: Read the actual part drawing, material requirements and specified cutting, drilling, bending, rolling, punching or welding operations and identify dimensions and tolerances
inputs: Actual part blueprint and operation requirements
outputs: Verified operation and dimensional requirements

steps.what: Measure the actual workpiece and establish real reference points, angles and available stock using compasses, protractors, dividers and rules, recording actual values and units
inputs: Actual stock or workpiece and measuring tools
outputs: Actual measured references, angles, dimensions and units

steps.what: Choose the actual operation locations and sequence, considering access, setup, tolerances and the effect of earlier operations on later work and specify any repeated angle or offset calculations
inputs: Actual measured references and blueprint requirements
outputs: Actual chosen operation sequence and explicit calculation inputs and formulas

steps.what: Calculate only the explicitly specified repeated coordinates, angles and offsets from the real verified reference dimensions and units
inputs: S2 actual dimensions and s3 explicit angle/offset formulas and chosen locations
outputs: Source-linked calculated layout values and invalid-input flags

steps.what: Write or mark the actual operation plan on the existing layout medium and check calculated values against the real stock, references and chosen sequence
inputs: Actual stock, explicit calculated values and chosen operation sequence
outputs: Actual checked operation layout and sequence plan

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, an existing shop geometry calculator or native layout calculation tool, for the worker's explicit repeated angle and offset formulas. Keep real measurements, sequence choices and the actual marked or written layout plan with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: A complex operation layout may repeat explicit angle and offset arithmetic after its geometry is chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed geometry formulas can be configured without inferring manufacturing decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Access, deformation and operation order depend on the actual workpiece.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a sequence that remains feasible as the real material changes.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicitly specified geometric formulas can be calculated deterministically while real layout measurements and operation sequencing remain skilled physical work.

assumptions: Representative actual multi-operation layout with observed repeated angle/offset calculations, not a measured average across all listed processes. Drawing authors supply requirements; s1 counts actual reading and s2 actual workpiece measurement and recording. No free digital workpiece model is assumed.

S4 requires actual reference origin, dimensions and units, angle convention and worker-selected explicit formula. S3 counts choosing these inputs and the sequence. Missing geometry remains manual. Try native shop calculation tools first; already performed calculator or CAD runtime yields zero new labour benefit.

The actual written/marked plan is split into s5 rather than hidden inside sequencing. No additional administrative report or system save is invented for a physical layout. Actual cutting, drilling, bending, rolling, punching or welding is subsequent production work, not a hidden automated action or saving here.

No external send, operative machine commit or production release occurs in this planning episode. Actual formal release would require its real final-version authority and own gated action. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt time priors.
unknowns: How much actual repeated geometric calculation remains beyond current tools?
Which layouts have explicit reusable formulas rather than individual physical construction?
research_questions: Observe actual measurement, sequence choice, repeated arithmetic and physical plan marking separately.

already_counted.description: Actual drawing reading, physical measurement, sequence judgement and final marked/written plan checking remain in s1-s3 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain explicit shop formula examples and unit checks beyond retained per-layout verification.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:15 actual repeated calculation points save less3 upkeep=12. Low: multiple workpiece faces require separate manual geometric construction for9 of15 calculation points, leaving6 explicit compatible formula points to save;6-3=3. Drawing15, real measurement25, sequence judgement35 and actual plan/check10 remain. A multi-face geometry compatibility case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Develop layouts from blueprints and templates using geometry and material knowledge

steps.what: Read actual blueprints and templates and verify the workpiece dimensions, material, units, design references and specified tolerances
inputs: Actual blueprints, templates and material requirements
outputs: Verified actual dimensional and material context

steps.what: Plan the actual layout, choosing references and allowances using real design requirements, material properties and heat effects and explicitly specifying the geometric formulas and parameters
inputs: Actual workpiece, verified blueprint dimensions and material context
outputs: Actual layout choices, measured parameters and explicit geometry/allowance specification

steps.what: Compute the explicitly specified trigonometric developments and dimensional offsets from verified actual parameters and selected allowances
inputs: S2 actual verified parameters, units and explicit geometry and allowance formulas
outputs: Calculated actual layout dimensions with formula trace and invalid-input list

steps.what: Develop the actual physical layout on the stock or existing template using the chosen references and checked calculated dimensions
inputs: Actual stock/template, selected references and actual calculated values
outputs: Actual developed physical layout

steps.what: Check the actual layout against the original blueprint and real material references, correcting dimensional or allowance errors
inputs: Actual physical layout and original blueprint/material requirements
outputs: Checked actual developed layout and unresolved issues

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the existing shop geometry and layout calculation tool, for explicitly selected trigonometric developments and offsets. Keep original {DOCS} reading, material and heat allowance choices, actual layout transfer and physical checking with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual selected layout geometry can require repeated manual trigonometric calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed formulas can be configured and traced to actual inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Real material and heat effects are not determined by a calculator alone.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and verify allowances appropriate to the actual workpiece.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit trigonometric developments and offset formulas are deterministic while material allowances and physical layout verification require skilled judgement.

assumptions: Conditional on observed actual repeated arithmetic beyond tools already used. Actual drawing authors provide blueprints; s1 counts reading and unit/material verification, s2 real measurement, reference choice and explicit formula/allowance specification. No clean digital geometry or automatic heat-effect judgement is assumed.

S3 requires actual length/angle/radius values and units, origin/reference convention and worker-selected allowance parameters under an explicit formula. It does not infer a material response. Out-of-formula developments stay manual. Try native calculation templates first; existing runtime earns no new saving.

S4 is the actual physical layout artefact and s5 actual checking; no separate administrative report or ordinary system save is invented. Subsequent manufacturing operation, formal engineering release or external handover is not hidden here and requires its real action and authority if included.
Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors, not measured output or a universal mix of layouts. Already-counted material judgement is not deducted again as incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Which actual trigonometric steps remain manual?
Which material/heat allowances have explicit valid formulas for real jobs?
research_questions: Observe actual layout development, separating material judgement and physical marking from repeated numeric development.

already_counted.description: Actual blueprint reading, reference/material/allowance decisions, physical layout development and complete physical checking remain in s1, s2, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain explicit development formulas and unit examples beyond retained per-layout material and dimensional checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:25 actual repeated numeric-development points save less3 upkeep=22. Low: nonuniform heat allowances and nonstandard curvature leave17 of25 development points requiring manual geometric treatment;8 explicit valid formula points save, less3 upkeep=5. All20 source reading,25 material/layout judgement,20 physical transfer and10 checking remain. A material/curvature formula-domain case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Design and prepare wood, paper or metal templates

steps.what: Find and read actual part dimensions, template requirements and existing reference drawings using native part and revision views
inputs: Actual part requirements and existing reference drawings
outputs: Verified actual template context

steps.what: Design the actual template outline, reference features and material thickness for the real wood, paper or metal use and specify exact scale and dimensional inputs
inputs: Actual part, verified requirements and intended template material
outputs: Actual template design and explicit full-scale outline settings

steps.what: Generate the exact specified full-scale outline and reference marks from the worker's verified actual dimensions using fixed scale and geometry settings
inputs: S2 actual template design, verified dimensions and explicit scale/reference settings
outputs: Actual full-scale template pattern with scale and dimension checks

steps.what: Prepare the actual wood, paper or metal template by physically transferring the checked pattern and forming the required template features with the actual appropriate tools
inputs: Actual template stock and checked full-scale pattern
outputs: Actually prepared physical template

steps.what: Fit and measure the actual template against the real part and references, checking scale, edges and identification and correcting defects
inputs: Actual prepared template and actual part/reference dimensions
outputs: Checked actual physical template

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the actual shop drawing and pattern tool, to render the worker's explicitly specified full-scale template outline from checked {DOCS} dimensions. Template design, physical preparation and fitting remain with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual selected outline may be manually redrawn to scale before physical template preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed geometry and scale settings can generate that exact outline.
tasks.still_hard: Material choice and an accurate physical fit require skilled hands-on work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a nominal pattern does not fit the real part.

ambition.what: Reduce demonstrated repeated full-scale pattern drafting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drawing tools can render explicit full-scale patterns while actual template material preparation and fitting remain physical work.

assumptions: Representative actual template job where a scaled outline is manually redrafted today, not a measured mix of all template materials. Actual drawing authors provide dimensions; s1 counts finding/checking them and s2 actual design and dimension capture. No free ready-to-use pattern or digitisation is assumed.

S3 requires actual geometry, dimensions/units, reference marks and scale specified by the worker. Try native full-scale drawing/printing first. Already generated patterns earn no new runtime saving; missing geometry remains manual design.

S4 counts all actual physical template transfer and preparation, including real tool handling; no automated cutting machine command is proposed. Any actual separately controlled machinery operation would need its current real authority and distinct action rather than being treated as automatically permitted by a pattern file.

The physical template is the actual output and s5 checks it; no new administrative report, formal release, external send or system save is invented. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Which actual outlines are still redrafted manually?
Does the current output path preserve verified full scale?
research_questions: Observe actual template design and making and count outline drafting separately from physical transfer, preparation and fitting.

already_counted.description: Actual source checking, template design, physical preparation and final fitting/checking remain in s1, s2, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain outline scale and reference settings and sample output calibration beyond retained per-template fitting checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10*.10=1 source point plus15 actual outline-redrafting points less3 upkeep=13. Low: the existing full-scale template is already available and the reference drawing is directly linked, so neither actual repeated drafting nor additional source navigation exists in that job; use the existing route with zero new upkeep and gain. Design20, physical preparation40 and fitting15 remain. A template-availability case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Add dimensional details to other workers' drawings

steps.what: Read the actual source blueprint or drawing, verify its revision, scale, units and geometry and capture the real additional dimension requirements
inputs: Actual drawing from its author and real dimensional-detail request
outputs: Verified drawing geometry and actual dimension requirements

steps.what: Choose the actual additional dimensions, references, tolerances and annotation positions needed to make the drawing unambiguous and map each to verified geometry
inputs: Actual verified drawing and dimension requirements
outputs: Actual selected dimension/reference/tolerance mapping

steps.what: Place the explicitly selected dimension lines and value labels from verified geometry using fixed native dimension styles and annotation mapping
inputs: S2 actual selected geometry, dimension styles, units, references and annotation positions
outputs: Actual working drawing with mapped dimensional details and non-associative geometry exceptions

steps.what: Check the complete actual drawing against originals and real geometry, checking dimension meaning, tolerances, units, readability and missing or contradictory details and correct errors
inputs: Actual dimensioned working drawing and original source requirements
outputs: Checked actual dimensioned working drawing

steps.what: Save the actual dimensioned working drawing in the same drawing system
inputs: Checked actual dimensioned working drawing
outputs: Stored actual working drawing

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the actual CAD or technical drawing application, to place explicitly chosen dimensions from verified geometry using native styles. The worker reads the original {DOCS} drawing, chooses meaningful details and checks the complete dimensioned drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual chosen dimensions may require repeated line and label placement or value retyping.
tasks.enabler_now: Native associative dimensions and annotation mappings can perform explicit placement deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: The right dimensions and tolerances must express actual design intent.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an ambiguity or contradiction that a correct numeric label would not resolve.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native drawing tools can place explicit associative dimensions while dimension selection, tolerance meaning and complete drawing checks remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional on actual repeated dimension-line/value placement beyond native tools already used. The actual source drawing author supplies geometry; s1 counts original revision/scale/unit checks and dimension capture and s2 actual dimension choice and explicit mapping. No free clean CAD model or automatic engineering intent is assumed.

S3 needs actual geometry references, selected measured dimension, unit, style, explicit tolerance and annotation position. Raster-only, non-associative or incompatible geometry stays manual. Try native dimension styles and associativity first; existing runtime earns zero new saving.

Actual drawing writing is explicit in s3 and complete author checking in s4; no extra approval of the author's work is added. The ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated with no saving.

The output is a working dimensioned drawing, not a manufacturing release or engineering-change commitment. A real issue or formal adoption needs the actual independent final-version authority and separate gated action; no external send is hidden in saving. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Which actual dimension placement is manual rather than already associative?
How much source geometry is raster-only or non-associative?

Source20, dimension judgement25, complete check24 and save1 remain. A source-geometry compatibility case, unmeasured.
